description: This file defines a static utility class 'RandomUtilities' for generating various random values and identifiers, primarily used in storage testing within Orleans-based systems. It includes constants for grain type codes, methods for generating random primitives, strings, and grain IDs, and maintains a dictionary of random generators keyed by type.

classes.name: RandomUtilities
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate random values, strings, and grain IDs for testing purposes in Orleans storage tests.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Generates a random value of the specified type, optionally within a specified range.

methods.name: GetRandomCharacters
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length from a given symbol set.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Creates a random GrainId for specified key type entries, either for string, Guid, or long keys, optionally as a key extension.
